entry.title: Google's Gemini Spark Now Controls Your Real Chrome Browser to Run Web Tasks
entry.summary: Gemini Spark now controls your real Chrome browser to handle web tasks, and rolls out to AI Pro subscribers in 160+ countries

entry.title: Google Builds Nano Banana 2 Into Earth to Reimagine Any Location
entry.summary: Google Earth now lets you generate AI images of any location on Earth using Nano Banana 2, grounded in real satellite and 3D data.

entry.title: Thinking Machines' Inkling-Small Beats Its 975B Teacher at a Quarter of the Cost
entry.summary: Thinking Machines releases Inkling-Small, a 12B-active MoE that beats its larger sibling on reasoning at a quarter of the compute cost

entry.title: LM Arena's AutoEval Ranks AI Models in Hours, Beating Frontier LLM Judges
entry.summary: Arena launches AutoEval, a reward-model-based system that scores new AI models in hours instead of days, with >0.98 correlation to live human votes

entry.title: OpenAI Slashes GPT-5.6 Luna Prices by 80% to Beat Anthropic
entry.summary: OpenAI slashes GPT-5.6 Luna prices by 80% and Terra by 20%, adds 2.5x faster Sol mode just three weeks after launch

entry.title: Simile Raises $200M to Simulate all 8 Billion People on Earth
entry.summary: Simile raises $200M at a $2B valuation to build a foundation model that simulates all 8 billion humans, with Fortune 100 customers already running tens of millions of predictions

entry.title: Perplexity Rebuilds Projects With Brain Memory to Beat Stateless AI Agents
entry.summary: Perplexity's Spaces become Projects: a persistent file system and self-improving Brain memory now power long-running agentic work for all users

entry.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2 Gives Humanoids Full-Body AI Control
entry.summary: Google DeepMind launches Gemini Robotics 2, bringing full-body humanoid control, multi-finger dexterity, and cross-robot collaboration to physical AI

entry.title: Sarvam AI's Saaras V4 Beats Global English Benchmarks With Single-Pass Multi-Speaker Recognition
entry.summary: Sarvam's new Saaras V4 Multi-speaker handles overlapping conversations in a single pass, while claiming state-of-the-art English ASR across seven global benchmarks.

entry.title: Sarvam AI Ships Bulbul V4 to Bring Emotional Voice to 11 Indian Languages
entry.summary: Sarvam AI's Bulbul V4 upgrades its Indic TTS engine with richer emotion, natural expression, and a wider vocal range across 11 Indian languages.

entry.title: Singapore's Agnes AI Builds a Reasoning Model That Uses 72% Fewer Tokens
entry.summary: Agnes AI's new reasoning model scores 39 on the intelligence index with top-tier coding performance, at just $0.45/$0.90 per 1M tokens

entry.title: Together AI's ThunderAgent Doubles GPU Throughput Running 192 Agents at Once
entry.summary: ThunderAgent fixes KV cache thrashing in agentic inference, delivering 2.5x higher throughput and ~10x lower latency -- accepted as an ICML 2026 Spotlight paper.
